result.summary: Added the two cross-cutting suites (shell invariant + accessibility) proving the nine real Agenda screens survive mount/interaction without a useShellConfig loop and are keyboard/axe clean on grids, dialogs and decision controls.
result.report:
Investigated which components are the actual "real screens" of the Agenda feature (each wraps `AppointmentFlowShell`, which is the sole other call site of `useShellConfig` besides `AgendaBoard`): `AgendaBoard` (list + Day/Week/Month), `AppointmentForm` (new), `BlockForm` (block/personal commitment), `BlockSeriesForm` (block series), `SeriesPreview` (appointment series), `AvailabilityExceptions`, `AppointmentDetail` (detail + lifecycle + history), `RescheduleFlow`, `CancelFlow`. `BlockForm`/`BlockSeriesForm`/`SeriesPreview`/`AvailabilityExceptions` are not yet wired into any `/agenda/*` route via `ProductAgendaScreen` (routing wiring wasn't part of any completed WU) — out of scope to fix, but they are still real screen components that must satisfy the shell invariant, so I rendered them directly, matching the goal015 pattern.

Created `apps/frontend/tests/goal016-shell-invariant.test.tsx`: mounts `ShellConfigProvider` + each of the nine screens with a shared, comprehensive mock of `@/shared/runtime/ProductRuntime`, then drives a representative interaction per screen (view-tab switching for the board, continuous typing for text fields, repeated radio/checkbox toggling for choice forms) — any invariant break throws "Maximum update depth exceeded" and fails the test without needing to catch it explicitly. 9 tests, all passing.

Created `apps/frontend/tests/goal016-a11y.test.tsx`: closes the three gaps no existing goal016 suite covers — (1) `AgendaBoard`'s Day/Week/Month grids never ran through axe before; (2) no suite asserted explicit keyboard focus in grids, dialogs, or decision controls (the `aria-allowed-role` rule is best-practice-only and excluded from `tests/support/a11y.ts`'s WCAG-tag `RULE_SET`, so link-vs-button role mistakes need explicit `getByRole` assertions, per the review015/ListItem precedent cited in the hint). Covers: Day/Week/Month grids (axe + explicit link/button role assertions + Tab-then-toHaveFocus + Enter-key activation), two dialog integrations (`AppointmentForm`'s and `CancelFlow`'s confirm dialogs — axe, initial focus lands on "Fechar", Tab-trap wraps, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger), and two decision-control integrations (`ConflictPanel` in `AppointmentForm`, `SeriesConflictPanel` in `BlockSeriesForm` — axe + explicit button roles + Tab order reaching each decision button). 7 tests, all passing. Neither file claims anything about layout, contrast, or viewport width — that remains `validate:ui`'s job, stated explicitly in the file's docblock.

Commands run: `npx vitest run tests/goal016-shell-invariant.test.tsx` (9/9 pass), `npx vitest run tests/goal016-a11y.test.tsx` (7/7 pass, after fixing two missing mock methods: `listAvailabilityExceptions`, `releaseHold`), `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (clean), `npx eslint tests/goal016-shell-invariant.test.tsx tests/goal016-a11y.test.tsx` (clean, after removing an unused fixture/import and two `@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion` non-null assertions), `npx vitest run tests/goal016-shell-invariant.test.tsx tests/goal016-a11y.test.tsx` (16/16 pass together), and the full suite `npx vitest run` (26 files, 213 tests, all pass — no regression). `git status --porcelain` confirms only the two expected new files were added; nothing else in the worktree was touched.

acceptance.criterion: A suíte monta ShellConfigProvider mais as telas reais de agenda e falha se alguma árvore entrar em Maximum update depth
acceptance.detail: goal016-shell-invariant.test.tsx mounts ShellConfigProvider + AgendaBoard/AppointmentForm/BlockForm/BlockSeriesForm/SeriesPreview/AvailabilityExceptions/AppointmentDetail/RescheduleFlow/CancelFlow with repeated state-changing interactions per screen; any invariant break throws uncaught and fails the test (no try/catch around render/interaction).

acceptance.criterion: Lista, visualizações e cada fluxo estão cobertos
acceptance.detail: AgendaBoard test covers list plus Day/Week/Month view switching; separate describe blocks cover new-appointment, block, block-series, appointment-series preview, availability-exceptions, detail+lifecycle+history, reschedule and cancel flows — all 9 real screen components identified via useShellConfig/AppointmentFlowShell usage.

acceptance.criterion: Acessibilidade verificada com axe sem violação nova, com asserção explícita de foco por teclado nas grades, nos diálogos e nos controles de decisão
acceptance.detail: goal016-a11y.test.tsx runs expectNoA11yViolations on Day/Week/Month grids, two dialog integrations, and two decision-control panels, each paired with tabUntilFocused/toHaveFocus assertions and explicit getByRole('link'|'button') checks; all 7 tests pass.

acceptance.criterion: Nenhuma afirmação de largura, contraste ou foco em tela autenticada é declarada como provada por esta suíte
acceptance.detail: goal016-a11y.test.tsx docblock states explicitly: 'O que esta suíte não prova: layout real, largura de viewport, contraste computado. Isso é npm run validate:ui, não jsdom.' No viewport/contrast assertions appear in either file.
